summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship phase 63 (read-chain navigation and rotation core) for the cipher-box sdk-core, covering read-chain traversal, grant/invite crypto, rotation engine, and a live e2e round-trip test — all in one autonomous session while the user was AFK.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully and verified (iteration 2, all 12 checker dimensions passed, 7/7 requirements + 10/10 decisions covered). Execution began but the transcript ends at the Wave 1 / plan 63-01 dispatch; ship-phase was not reached.

repo: Phase 63 is backend crypto only (frontend: false); UI and drift gates are non-blocking/skipped for sdk-core phases.
API health endpoint is at localhost:3000/health; CI already uses a bounded poll loop — use that pattern instead of bare sleep for test startup waits.
Worktrees are explicitly discouraged for this repo due to node_modules leaks and api:generate cross-contamination; sequential main-tree execution is the safe default.
Plans 63-01 and 63-04 share folder.test.ts, making parallel wave-1 execution risky — sequential dispatch required.
Rotation engine plan (63-03) creates 4 named seams for Phase 64, establishing an explicit cross-phase dependency.
GSD commit helper consistently reports false-negatives (exit non-zero) even when the commit lands; truth is git log, not the helper's exit code.
Drift gate (stale .planning/codebase/ map) is non-blocking at plan time as long as CONTEXT.md and RESEARCH.md carry current implementation-site references.
Step 5.5 of plan-phase: VALIDATION.md is written from template at research time with body unfilled — it must be populated after plans exist, not before.

code.finding: Used bare `sleep 12` for API startup; replaced with a bounded health-poll loop mirroring the CI pattern (curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health with retry limit).

workflow: GSD plan-phase sequence: research → VALIDATION.md scaffold → pattern-mapper → API-surface regen → planner (opus) → plan-checker (sonnet) with iteration loop until PASSED.

Plan-checker iteration 1 caught three fixable artifact issues (RESEARCH.md missing RESOLVED markers, VALIDATION.md unfilled, fragile sleep) — none were design flaws. Orchestrator could pre-screen these before spawning the checker.
Pattern mapper returned 10/10 analogs; API-SURFACE was empty (0 symbols) for this phase and was safely omitted from the planner prompt.
When running AFK, verifying commit.gpgsign=false at repo level before spawning subagents prevents biometric-prompt hangs during automated commits.

friction: GSD commit helper reported false-negatives on every commit (exit non-zero while commit actually landed), requiring a git log verification step after each commit to confirm success.

Plan-checker iteration 1 returned a blocker for a formatting issue (missing RESOLVED markers in RESEARCH.md) rather than a design flaw, forcing a full re-spawn of the checker for what was a trivial fix.
VALIDATION.md per-task map had to be manually constructed by scraping task IDs and automated commands from all 7 plan files — this data could have been templated by the planner directly.
Transcript ends mid-execution (Wave 1 just dispatched), so the full session goal (plan + execute + ship) was not observable in the provided excerpt.
